benchmark: frontier-learning: can ECDEV stop a crawl early on low marginal yield, or narrow crawl scope from URL/path evidence, without losing observed commerce evidence?
method: 8 catalogues crawled live through ecdev.research.run under ECDEV robots, AI-agent, DNS/IP, redirect, body and pacing policy (max_pages 80, depth 3, max_urls 400, no login, no browser); each fetched page re-extracted offline from its stored raw capture with ECDEV's own extractor; policies replayed offline on the per-page traces. The bounded 80-page trace is the baseline, not the catalogue.

catalogues.why: collection page refused by the 4 MiB body bound (BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED); a refusal is not a failed experiment

books.toscrape.com.structure: scraping-practice catalogue: category pages, numbered pagination, semantic-slug product pages with an id suffix, no structured product data
books.toscrape.com.crawl: HANDLED 80, 320 pending; ECDEV extracts 0 products (prices only in unstructured HTML)

webscraper.io.structure: a vendor site that hosts a practice shop under /test-sites: documentation, solutions and blog pages dominate the host; catalogue is numeric-id products in nested categories

scrapeme.live.structure: WooCommerce practice shop: semantic-slug product pages under /shop/, plus forums, property and WordPress pages on the same host; add-to-cart URLs robots-denied

ruggable.com.structure: Shopify store: /collections/* navigation, products at /products/*, a sibling prefix

www.fashionnova.com.structure: Shopify store with HTML sitemap pages, collection listings carrying many JSON-LD items, products at /products/*
www.fashionnova.com.crawl: HANDLED 78, 1 body over 4 MiB, 1 network error

us.puma.com.structure: site with category listings and an HTML sitemap section of hundreds of pages

www.otto.de.structure: German multi-department retailer: deep department paths, listing pages with many items, filter query parameters

components: new_identities (page-subject products, key: GTIN, else brand+MPN, else host+SKU, else canonical URL)
new_listing_identities (products shown on a listing page, not the page subject)
new_fields_on_known (a known identity gaining a field)
new_assertions (identity, field, value) triples never seen before
new_conflicts (a field with a second distinct value)
children_admitted (frontier expansion, reported but not counted as yield)
yield_definition.low_yield_page: no new identity, listing identity or field
yield_definition.note: identifier-bearing identities, enrichment fields and conflicts were 0 on every trace: no catalogue re-observed a product on a second page, no product carried a GTIN/MPN in ECDEV's extraction, and no value ever disagreed. Those components cannot discriminate between policies on this sample.

early_stopping.finding: No robust operating point. A rule that loses nothing on one catalogue loses 78% to 100% of the observed identities on another: ruggable.com went 68 consecutive fetches without yield before its products appeared, puma.com 45, and puma.com and scrapeme.live found their first yield only at fetch 46 and 34, so consecutive-low rules with N up to 30 stop before them. In leave-one-catalogue-out a rule met the 2% bound on every training site for only 1 of 7 held-out catalogues, and on that one (ruggable.com) it lost 78% of the identities. Region-local rules that spare navigation with productive descendants lose nothing and save 50-65% on webscraper.io, scrapeme.live and puma.com, have no safe setting at all on ruggable.com (0 of 24 policies), and when constrained to no loss save at most 20% on fashionnova.com and 0% on otto.de.

path_scope.finding: Host-wide crawling wastes most of the budget when a catalogue lives in a subdirectory of a larger site (webscraper.io: 54 of 80 fetches were documentation and marketing pages; scrapeme.live: 47 of 80 forums, property and WordPress pages; puma.com: 42 of 80 HTML sitemap pages). The right prefix cannot be read from structure: a prefix that is the seed's own subtree saved 71-93% with no loss, while the wrong sibling prefix lost every product (scrapeme /product-category/, ruggable /collections/ because products sit under /products/). Page yield also misleads: navigation shapes with zero page yield (ruggable /collections/*: 64 pages, 0 yield) held the only path to the products (subtree yield 7).
path_scope.decision: IMPLEMENT only the explicit mechanism: ecdev.research.run include_path_prefixes (operator-stated, default whole host, seeds and robots-declared sitemaps always admitted, skipped links counted and exemplified in the run record, coverage labelled LIMITED_TO_OPERATOR_SCOPE). No learned or default scope: DELIBERATE_NO_CHANGE.

other_findings: allbirds.com collection page and one fashionnova.com page declare a body over the 4 MiB bound: 2 refusals in 640 attempted fetches. The bound is a safety limit; whether real catalogue pages need more is open (2 observations).
No page in these traces was policy-permitted, structurally empty and product-bearing after script execution that the benchmarks could identify; the dynamic-page conclusion is unchanged.
puma.com and otto.de returned listing items but no page-subject product within 80 pages: a crawl that stops at listings has shelf-price observations only.
limits: 8 catalogues attempted, 7 traced, 5 with any ECDEV-extractable products; two practice sites, five real stores
one crawl per site, 80 fetched pages each, one capture time; the baseline is a bounded trace, never the catalogue
identifier-bearing, enrichment and conflict components were zero everywhere, so they could not discriminate policies
replay skips a stopped region's later pages and their recorded descendants; a real policy would also re-prioritise the frontier, which replay cannot show
leave-one-out used a 2% bound chosen before looking at held-out results; the policy grid was fixed before any held-out evaluation

#!/bin/bash
# sequential live catalogue crawls under ECDEV policy; one engine root per site
cd /home/user/ECDEV
export ECDEV_EGRESS_PROXY="$HTTPS_PROXY" ECDEV_EGRESS_CA_BUNDLE=/root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt
S=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-ECDEV/c000280f-3151-5564-9330-dca84c370647/scratchpad/cat
while read name url; do
  rm -rf $S/$name; 
  target/release/ecdev_side live $S/$name ecdev.research.run "{\"market\":\"PUBLIC_WEB\",\"query\":\"product\",\"sources\":[{\"url\":\"$url\"}],\"max_pages\":80,\"max_depth\":3,\"max_urls\":400,\"deadline_seconds\":1200,\"force_refresh\":true}" > $S/$name.json 2>$S/$name.err
  echo "$name done $(date +%s)" >> $S/progress.txt
done <<L
books https://books.toscrape.com/
webscraper https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static
scrapeme https://scrapeme.live/shop/
allbirds https://www.allbirds.com/collections/mens-shoes
L
echo ALLDONE >> $S/progress.txt
